name: divergent-validation

rubric.criterion: Accounts for independently changing label policy and firmware protocol. Similar syntax alone is insufficient evidence of a shared domain rule.

Separate functions, composed small mechanical helpers, and a bounded shared validator can pass if policy authority stays explicit and changing project rules leaves the device protocol untouched. A configurable framework needs evidence of reduced caller knowledge and total cost.
Shows the resulting interface and a concrete next naming change against code rather than asserting that all duplication is good or bad.

false_positives: Rejecting every shared mechanical helper regardless of hidden policy and caller burden.
Requiring a specific number of files or classes.

source.purpose: Portable adversarial case derived from module-boundary research; not copied from a production checkout.
